items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere—wouldn't activate if major injury worry (Cardinals caveat).
items.why: Active designation after ankle injury; ETR expected him to play.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor actual workload.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara out: snaps Etienne 53, Kendre Miller 26, CJ Donaldson 15; routes 24/7/5; opps 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne lead but not pure workhorse; Miller handcuff viable.
items.opportunity: Etienne 53 snaps/18 opps lead but shared.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game back: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets for team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Strong route and target share in return despite limited snaps.
items.implication: Encouraging volume for WR1 upside going forward if snap share rises.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid appears over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%); will move needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside locked in if sustained.

items.text: Jonathan Taylor even in loss: 48/54 snaps (89%), 20 routes/34 dropbacks (59%), 4 targets (13%), 23/24 RB opps (96%). Colts don't trust backups.
items.implication: Elite RB1 volume locked; ignore game script noise.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious; MRI upcoming, day-to-day; would have returned if playoff game.
items.why: Sources: left early vs IND but not considered serious.
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible Week 2 sit. Beneficiaries if out: other Ravens WRs.

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out due to wrist injury.
items.implication: Multi-week absence possible; Flowers injury compounds Ravens WR depth.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active (calf).
Brock Bowers (meniscus trim) OUT Week 1; realistic chance miss only one game, return Week 2 vs LAC possible.
items.why: Meniscus surgery Tuesday; team optimistic short absence.

items.text: Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps; Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks worked side early week (groin tweak alleged).
items.why: Clear Hubbard lead; Brooks limited possibly by tweak.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible (preseason stance unchanged).
items.why: Week 1 quiet but long-term Bears offense belief.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not (preseason talk with new OC Mannion); also hyped Loveland.
items.why: Preseason emphasis validated by early usage.
